about: Tiny Speck's c2.glitch.bz sound files from Sounds.zip, a fan re-upload of the server's files. Installed byte for byte by tools/sound/install-sounds-zip.mjs; catalogued by build-sound-keys.mjs as origin sounds-zip. Licence: research/coverage/g312-provenance.md, Original sounds (Austin 2026-10-28: Tiny Speck's own recordings ship).

source.name: Sounds.zip
source.linkedFrom: https://www.youtube.com/@GlitchGameMusic (an unofficial fan channel; its description links the zip as all the audio that could be salvaged)
source.naming: 751 of its files keep the server name <unix-ts>-<name>.mp3 of c2.glitch.bz/sounds/<YYYY-MM>/
source.byteMatches: 68 of its files are byte-identical to files the game already shipped: 37 of the 38 Wayback c2 captures (TOXIC_MOON = 1322689572-Also_Sprach_Zarathustra_Loop_3.2_fades.mp3 md5 24feb2c9..., HERE_YOU_GO_LIGHTER = here_you_go_lighter.mp3 md5 3c1f0563..., HARVEST, STEWARTDOLL1-14, ...; PETRIFIED_ROCK is there only as a later take), SAVE_AND_CHECKOUT from Slack's mirror (as 1308081497-Go_To_Checkout_1.2.mp3), the 3 Esquibeth overlay recordings, and 27 downloads-page files (Tubamaphone_1292397289.mp3 md5 3e406f7d..., winter_holiday_1344997255.mp3 md5 4987c49b..., and the HELL file 1274906921-Bongbong.mp3, which is Dirge-of-the-Damned_1291886020.mp3 byte for byte)

players/inc_making.js:830: a machine's job is done (home machines, machine rooms, a machine used from the pack). The file is the first machine set's own (uploaded 2011-04-08 with chassis1, engine1, plates1 and collect, all named <key>_30.mp3), and a fan table of the server's files calls it "Machine ready for use". A double beep, 0.19 s of sound after 0.29 s of silence.
files.doubt: Name match only: the sounds XML is lost. A later file, 1322173657-Ready_1.1.mp3 (2011-11, 2.6 s), has the same name; the composer's later sound-effects release titles that one as the Still's ready chime, so it plays as STILL_READY (items/still.js:413) and not here. Which of the two the last XML gave READY is not known.
files.gainWhy: The file peaks at -32.2 dB, 20 dB under the rest of its set (chassis1 -11.8, engine1 -12.4, plates1 -12.0). The bytes ship untouched; the sound board plays the key 20 dB up (peak -12.2 dB, loudest 100 ms -21.2 dB against engine1 -22.1 and chassis1 -22.9).
